items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: We had, in fact we had two trumpets on the roof but we only had one trumpet when we made the record. Yeah. The other trumpet player, his name was Charlie Wagner.

ctx.x: Did you play there with Monk on the Bienville Roof for a while?

Yes, I played with Monk on the Bienville Roof. We had, in fact we had two trumpets on the roof but we only had one trumpet when we made the record. Yeah. The other trumpet player, his name was Charlie Wagner.
Oh I've heard of him, he was out in Metry, he died just a year or two ago.
